surface_verification.justification: The bug this closes (an in-memory Map staying stale across process boundaries) is invisible to in-process test doubles by construction — proving it needs a real second OS process's worth of independence: a real Hono app served over a real HTTP port (@hono/node-server), backed by two real SdkSessionsStore instances sharing one on-disk file via the real proper-lockfile (not the test-double lock), where the 'foreign' claim is written by a store instance the running server process never touches again. Never points at the operator's actual ~/.shipwright-webui/sdk-sessions.json (config.ts's registryDir has no env override, so the compiled production server binary was deliberately not used) — a scratch temp-dir file instead, wired through the same createExternalRoutes() construction. 8/8 checks passed, proving AC (a)-(d) end to end. The process crashed on process.exit() with a Windows libuv UV_HANDLE_CLOSING assertion AFTER every check had already printed pass — a known class of Node-on-Windows forced-exit timing hazard, not part of the HTTP round trips under test; recorded as a degraded item above rather than root-caused further.
